meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (Annual Survey of Industries)
meta.revisionPolicy: ASI results are final on release; occasional revisions get a fresh vintage.
meta.note: Monetary series are as published in the source: ₹ lakh (1 lakh = 100,000; 1 crore = 100 lakh). Count series (factories, persons) are plain counts. Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. Newer UTs (e.g. Ladakh) and reorganised states have shorter spans; interior missing years are disclosed in gaps.
